story: AANI GEMAS began in 1987 as a small bench in Mumbai, where our founder shaped her first 18K gold ring by hand. Today the atelier is still guided by the same belief: jewelry should be personal, lasting and beautiful up close.

Every piece is designed in-house, set by master artisans and inspected under magnification before it leaves our workshop. We work with GIA certified stones and responsibly sourced gold, and we share the real gold rate so pricing is always transparent.

values.title: Handcrafted
values.text: Every ring, pendant and bracelet is shaped and finished by hand, never mass-produced.

values.title: Certified & Ethical
values.text: GIA certified gemstones and responsibly sourced 18K gold with full documentation.

values.title: Made to Last
values.text: A lifetime craftsmanship warranty, free resizing and complimentary care for every piece.

values.title: Truly Personal
values.text: Design your own ring and see transparent live pricing as you choose metal and stone.

shipping-policy.title: Shipping Policy
shipping-policy.intro: Every order is insured, tracked and signed for. Here is how we get your piece safely to you.

sections.heading: Processing time
body: Ready-to-ship pieces are dispatched within 2–3 business days. Made-to-order and customised pieces, including rings from Design Your Ring, are handcrafted and typically ship within 4–6 weeks.
You will receive an email at every stage: order confirmed, crafting, quality check and shipped.

sections.heading: Delivery methods & rates
body: Standard Delivery (5–7 business days) is $25 and free on orders over $500. Express Delivery (2–3 business days) is $45. Overnight Delivery (next business day) is $95.
International orders carry an additional $20 handling charge and may take longer depending on customs.

sections.heading: Insurance & signature
body: All parcels are fully insured for their declared value and require an adult signature on delivery. We cannot leave jewelry unattended.

sections.heading: Customs & duties
body: International customers are responsible for any import duties or taxes charged by their country. These are not included in our prices.

returns.title: Returns & Exchange
returns.intro: Not completely in love? Return or exchange within 30 days — no questions asked.

sections.heading: 30-day returns
body: You may return any ready-to-ship piece within 30 days of delivery for a full refund, provided it is unworn, in original condition and in its original packaging with certificates.

sections.heading: Custom & engraved pieces
body: Because they are made especially for you, bespoke rings and engraved items cannot be returned, but we will happily resize or repair them free of charge for 60 days.

sections.heading: How to return
body: Contact us with your order number to receive a prepaid, insured return label. Once we receive and inspect the piece, your refund is issued to the original payment method within 5–7 business days.

sections.heading: Exchanges
body: Prefer a different size or design? Exchanges are free within 30 days. Any price difference is charged or refunded.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.intro: We collect only what we need to serve you and we never sell your personal information.

sections.heading: Information we collect
body: Account details (name, email, phone), delivery addresses, order history and, if you contact us, the messages you send. Payment details are handled by our payment processor and are never stored by us.

sections.heading: How we use it
body: To process and deliver orders, provide support, send order updates and, with your consent, share news about new collections. You can unsubscribe at any time.

sections.heading: Cookies & storage
body: We use essential cookies and local storage to remember your cart, wishlist, theme and sign-in. Analytics cookies are used only in aggregate.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data at any time by contacting privacy@aanigems.com.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: By using this site and placing an order you agree to the terms below.

sections.heading: Orders & pricing
body: All prices are shown in US dollars and may change with the gold market. The price confirmed at checkout is the price you pay. We may cancel an order if a pricing error occurs, with a full refund.

sections.heading: Payment
body: We accept major cards, UPI and net banking. Orders are processed once payment is authorised.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
body: All designs, images and content on this site belong to AANI GEMAS and may not be reproduced without written permission.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
body: To the extent permitted by law, our liability is limited to the purchase price of the product concerned.

sections.heading: Governing law
body: These terms are governed by the laws of India. Disputes fall under the jurisdiction of the courts of Mumbai.

warranty.title: Warranty & Lifetime Care
warranty.intro: Every AANI GEMAS piece is backed by a lifetime craftsmanship warranty and complimentary care.

sections.heading: What's covered
body: Manufacturing defects, faulty stone settings, broken clasps and prongs, and loss of plating in normal wear, for the lifetime of the piece.

sections.heading: What is not covered
body: Accidental damage, loss or theft, damage from chemicals, and wear from improper use. We can often repair these for a fair charge.

sections.heading: Complimentary care
body: Free professional cleaning, inspection and polishing once a year, and free resizing within 60 days of purchase.

sections.heading: Making a claim
body: Contact us with your order number and photos. We will send an insured prepaid label and repair or replace the piece.

items.a: Ready-to-ship pieces arrive in 5–7 business days with Standard Delivery. Made-to-order pieces ship within 4–6 weeks.
Standard shipping is free on orders over $500. Otherwise rates start at $25.
Yes. Use the Track Order page with your order number and email, or view it under My Account.
30-day free returns on unworn, ready-to-ship pieces. Custom and engraved items are repaired or resized instead.
Free resizing within 60 days of purchase on most rings. Beyond that, a small fee applies.

items.q: How do I care for my jewelry?
items.a: Store it in the provided pouch, avoid harsh chemicals and clean gently with a soft cloth. We offer complimentary yearly cleaning.

items.q: What gold purity do you use?
items.a: All our gold jewelry is 18K (75% pure gold), hallmarked and certified.
Yes. All diamonds and major gemstones are GIA certified and come with their certificate.
Gold-based prices follow the live gold rate so you only ever pay a fair, transparent price.

items.q: How does Design Your Ring work?
items.a: Choose a setting, a stone and your size in four steps and see a live price. Our artisans then craft it to order.

items.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Visa, Mastercard, AMEX, PayPal, UPI and net banking.
Yes. Payments are encrypted and processed by a PCI-compliant provider.

testimonials.name: Priya Mehta
testimonials.text: I ordered the Lumiere Diamond Solitaire for my engagement. The craftsmanship is beyond anything I've seen — every detail is perfect. My fiance was speechless.

testimonials.name: Sophie Durand
testimonials.text: The Design Your Ring feature is incredible. I chose the Elise Halo with a Ceylon Sapphire, and the real-time pricing with live gold rates made everything feel transparent.

testimonials.name: Aisha Khan
testimonials.text: Ordered the Cascade Sapphire Drops and the Infini Diamond Tennis Bracelet together. The packaging alone is worth a review — pure luxury. Both pieces are stunning.

testimonials.name: James Hartley
testimonials.text: As someone who knew nothing about jewelry, the product pages gave me all the confidence I needed. Bought the Aurora Solitaire for my wife — she hasn't taken it off.
